request:
Which methods defined directly in the body of the synchronous `Client` class in httpx/_client.py have no docstring? Include private and dunder methods; exclude methods inherited from BaseClient. Give their symbol IDs.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Selects methods whose qualname is directly under Client (no nested dots) in httpx/_client.py, so only methods defined in the Client class body are included, and keeps those with no docstring. This naturally excludes inherited methods and methods of nested classes.
